coverage_credit_policy: Credit only after an observed DUT handshake/event and a passing independent checker.

bins.feature: CPU read on core 0
bins.legal_preconditions: Cacheable aligned 64-bit word; CPU request accepted and response completed.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Directed MESI sequence and seeded random read operations.
bins.required_monitor_event: CPU request_accept and response_complete for core 0.
bins.checker: DualCoreCpuDriver lifecycle checks; CoherenceScoreboard checks returned read data.

bins.feature: CPU read on core 1
bins.legal_preconditions: Cacheable aligned 64-bit word; CPU request accepted and response completed.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Directed ownership sequence and seeded random read operations.
bins.required_monitor_event: CPU request_accept and response_complete for core 1.
bins.checker: DualCoreCpuDriver lifecycle checks; CoherenceScoreboard checks returned read data.

bins.feature: CPU write on core 0
bins.legal_preconditions: Cacheable word; nonzero legal byte mask; request accepted and response completed.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Directed ownership sequence and seeded random writes with byte masks.
bins.required_monitor_event: CPU request_accept and response_complete for core 0.
bins.checker: DualCoreCpuDriver lifecycle checks; CoherenceScoreboard applies the byte mask and checks subsequent reads.

bins.feature: CPU write on core 1
bins.legal_preconditions: Cacheable word; nonzero legal byte mask; request accepted and response completed.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Directed ownership sequence and seeded random writes with byte masks.
bins.required_monitor_event: CPU request_accept and response_complete for core 1.
bins.checker: DualCoreCpuDriver lifecycle checks; CoherenceScoreboard applies the byte mask and checks subsequent reads.

bins.feature: MESI I to E
bins.legal_preconditions: Line is absent from both L1s and a core issues GetS without a peer copy.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Cold read from core 0.
bins.required_monitor_event: L1 metadata_commit observed for the requesting core.
bins.checker: Independent CoherenceScoreboard predicts state; observed commit is compared after checked transaction completion.

bins.feature: MESI I to S
bins.legal_preconditions: Line is absent from requester L1 and present in peer L1 in a shareable state.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Core 0 cold read followed by core 1 read of the same line.
bins.required_monitor_event: L1 metadata_commit observed for the requesting core.
bins.checker: Independent CoherenceScoreboard predicts state; observed commit is compared after checked transaction completion.

bins.feature: MESI S to M
bins.legal_preconditions: Both L1s hold a shared copy and one core issues a write.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Core 1 store after both cores read the line.
bins.required_monitor_event: L1 metadata_commit observed for writer and peer invalidation/downgrade.
bins.checker: Independent CoherenceScoreboard predicts both cores' states and checks observed metadata commits.

bins.feature: MESI M to S
bins.legal_preconditions: Peer requests shared access to a line modified by the current owner.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Core 1 writes then core 0 reads the same line.
bins.required_monitor_event: Owner snoop response and L1 metadata_commit for owner downgrade.
bins.checker: Independent CoherenceScoreboard checks returned latest data and observed metadata commit.

bins.feature: AXI read refill burst
bins.legal_preconditions: Cacheable cold miss reaches AXI; 64-byte line is returned as eight 64-bit beats.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Directed cold miss with initialized backing memory.
bins.required_monitor_event: Accepted AR and eight accepted R beats ending with RLAST.
bins.checker: Axi4BackingMemoryAgent checks ID, address, burst shape, beat order, data, and RLAST; CPU data checked by reference model.

bins.feature: Out-of-order AXI read completion across IDs
bins.legal_preconditions: Two different cache lines miss concurrently and obtain distinct accepted AXI IDs.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Paired distinct-line CPU cold misses; memory reorder window delays earlier request.
bins.required_monitor_event: Two accepted AR IDs and R completion order reversed from AR acceptance order.
bins.checker: AXI ID/beat scoreboard checks response routing and CPU data; test asserts completion order.

bins.feature: Two overlapping refill MSHRs
bins.legal_preconditions: Two distinct set/line misses can allocate separate refill contexts.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Paired CPU cold misses with delayed memory response.
bins.required_monitor_event: Observed refill MSHR valid bitmap has population count two.
bins.checker: Passive occupancy monitor plus AXI transaction/CPU data scoreboard.

bins.feature: MMIO byte-masked write/readback
bins.legal_preconditions: CPU accesses a mapped MMIO register with a supported transfer size and nonzero byte mask.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Write lower bytes, then read back through the other core.
bins.required_monitor_event: MMIO request_accept and response_complete with matching address/mask.
bins.checker: Independent MMIO register model checks masked merge and returned read data.

bins.feature: APB read-only and unmapped access errors
bins.legal_preconditions: Negative accesses are deliberately issued only to read-only CSR and unmapped APB offset.
bins.stimulus_strategy: APB CSR read, attempted write to read-only counter, and bad-address access.
bins.required_monitor_event: APB access_complete with PSLVERR for both invalid operations.
bins.checker: ApbMasterAgent bounds access and checks PSLVERR response.

bins.feature: Concurrent MMIO read, cache miss refill, and APB miss-counter read
bins.legal_preconditions: CPU0 MMIO read response is delayed while CPU1 has an accepted cache miss and an AXI refill with source-side RVALID gaps. The integrated top holds RREADY high outside reset, so this is not receiver backpressure.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Launch both CPU lanes together, wait for accepted AR, then read the APB miss counter before the final R beat and before the MMIO response; inject legal gaps between R beats.
bins.required_monitor_event: MMIO request/response, CPU request/response, AXI AR/eight R beats, and APB access are correlated by address and cycle ordering.
bins.checker: CPU driver lifecycle; independent cache reference data; MMIO register model; AXI ID/beat/data checker and RVALID-gap count; APB counter value; monitor cycle-overlap assertions; no MMIO L1/Directory allocation.

bins.feature: Dual-core MMIO request arbitration
bins.legal_preconditions: Both cores issue requests to distinct mapped MMIO addresses.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Paired masked writes followed by independent readbacks.
bins.required_monitor_event: Both MMIO request_accept/response_complete events observed at their expected addresses.
bins.checker: Packed CPU driver checks lane lifecycle; MMIO model checks masked register values and both readbacks.

bins.feature: MMIO bypass during peer cache miss
bins.legal_preconditions: One core issues mapped MMIO access while the other issues a cacheable cold miss.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Paired MMIO write and cacheable read with delayed AXI memory.
bins.required_monitor_event: MMIO handshake and AXI AR overlap in the same test window.
bins.checker: MMIO reference model and cache scoreboard independently check both responses.

bins.feature: APB CSR read during AXI refill
bins.legal_preconditions: A cacheable refill is outstanding while an APB CSR read is issued.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Wait for accepted AXI AR, then read access-cycle CSR before refill completes.
bins.required_monitor_event: AXI read context active and APB access_complete observed.
bins.checker: APB master checks bounded completion; AXI agent tracks outstanding refill lifecycle.

bins.feature: Reset cancels AXI read and allows ID reuse
bins.legal_preconditions: Delayed AXI read is outstanding when reset is asserted.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Start cold miss, assert reset before R completion, then repeat miss.
bins.required_monitor_event: System reset_cancel and a later AR reusing the cancelled ID.
bins.checker: AXI agent verifies cancellation/ID reuse; CPU scoreboard checks fresh returned data and no stale response.

bins.feature: AXI read response error fail-stop
bins.legal_preconditions: Fault injection returns non-OK RRESP for a selected cache line.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Inject RRESP error during cold refill.
bins.required_monitor_event: Accepted R beat with error response and DUT fatal_error assertion.
bins.checker: Test checks fail-stop, absence of CPU success response, and agent error record.

bins.feature: Reset cancels delayed MMIO response
bins.legal_preconditions: MMIO request is accepted but its response is delayed when reset is asserted.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Issue mapped MMIO read with long response delay, reset, then retry.
bins.required_monitor_event: Reset cancellation and absence of stale MMIO/CPU response.
bins.checker: MMIO agent tracks pending request cancellation and checks fresh retry completion.

bins.feature: Four simultaneous refill MSHRs
bins.legal_preconditions: Four independent cache misses can be concurrently outstanding from CPU requestors.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Not currently generatable through the blocking dual-lane CPU API; use a dedicated block-level MSHR test.
bins.required_monitor_event: Four distinct active refill contexts with correctly routed completions.
bins.checker: Future context lifecycle checker and per-request data scoreboard.

bins.feature: Out-of-order AXI write response completion
bins.legal_preconditions: Multiple accepted write transactions have distinct IDs and completed AW/W handshakes.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Not currently generated by the integrated cache top; standalone adapter tests cover write ID lifecycle separately.
bins.required_monitor_event: Distinct accepted AW/W transactions and B responses returned in a different order.
bins.checker: Future AXI write ID lifecycle checker.

bins.feature: MESI I to M
bins.legal_preconditions: Line absent from both L1s; core issues a cacheable store.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Cold CPU store obtains writable ownership.
bins.required_monitor_event: Directory GetM acceptance and requester L1 metadata commit to M.
bins.checker: FullSystemEnv advances an independent coherence/data scoreboard from CPU transactions and credits only after observed L1 metadata commits agree with the model and CPU completion.

bins.feature: MESI E to M
bins.legal_preconditions: Requester holds a clean exclusive line.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Local store to an E line.
bins.required_monitor_event: L1 metadata commit E->M after completed CPU store.
bins.checker: FullSystemEnv advances an independent coherence/data scoreboard from CPU transactions and credits only after observed L1 metadata commits agree with the model and CPU completion.

bins.feature: MESI E to S
bins.legal_preconditions: Peer holds E and other core issues GetS.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Read same line from the other CPU.
bins.required_monitor_event: Owner snoop/read response and both L1 metadata commits to S.
bins.checker: FullSystemEnv advances an independent coherence/data scoreboard from CPU transactions and credits only after observed L1 metadata commits agree with the model and CPU completion.

bins.feature: MESI E to I
bins.legal_preconditions: Peer holds E and other core issues GetM.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Remote CPU store to same line.
bins.required_monitor_event: Observed GetM, owner invalidation commit and requester commit to M.
bins.checker: FullSystemEnv advances an independent coherence/data scoreboard from CPU transactions and credits only after observed L1 metadata commits agree with the model and CPU completion.

bins.feature: MESI S to I
bins.legal_preconditions: Both cores hold S and one core upgrades to M.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Store by one sharer.
bins.required_monitor_event: Observed snoop invalidate and peer metadata commit to I.
bins.checker: FullSystemEnv advances an independent coherence/data scoreboard from CPU transactions and credits only after observed L1 metadata commits agree with the model and CPU completion.

bins.feature: MESI M to I
bins.legal_preconditions: One core holds M and peer issues GetM.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Remote CPU store by the other core.
bins.required_monitor_event: Observed GetM and former owner metadata commit to I.
bins.checker: FullSystemEnv advances an independent coherence/data scoreboard from CPU transactions and credits only after observed L1 metadata commits agree with the model and CPU completion.

bins.feature: Concurrent same-line stores from both cores
bins.legal_preconditions: Both blocking CPU lanes offer writes to distinct words in the same cache line; writes are accepted and completed.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Simultaneous paired stores followed by independent readbacks of both words.
bins.required_monitor_event: Both Directory request handshakes, both CPU completions, and valid final L1 metadata commits.
bins.checker: Independent coherence/data reference model is advanced in observed Directory acceptance order; both architectural words are read back and checked.

bins.feature: Dirty L1 replacement PutM concurrent with remote Snoop
bins.legal_preconditions: One core has a dirty line and fills its same-set L1; the peer requests the dirty line while the owner requests a replacement line.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Paired remote read and fifth same-set line request with both CPU lanes active.
bins.required_monitor_event: PutM for the victim, Snoop accept/response for that line, and both CPU completions.
bins.checker: CPU data is checked against seeded/dirty values; protocol error remains clear; PutM and Snoop events are checked in the same race window.

bins.feature: APB event counters, dirty writeback accounting, and reset semantics
bins.legal_preconditions: Successful cold/hit/snoop accesses, same-set dirty L2 replacements, then system reset.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Read all CSR offsets at reset, check exact hit/miss/snoop/completion deltas, force ten dirty same-set lines, then reset and reread all CSRs.
bins.required_monitor_event: CPU transaction completions and AXI write handshakes/completions for dirty victims.
bins.checker: APB reads check exact event counts and reset-to-zero; AXI agent checks eight ordered full-strobe beats, AW/B association, serialized completion, and backing-memory writeback data.

bins.feature: Integrated AXI dirty writeback burst lifecycle and serialization ordering
bins.legal_preconditions: Dirty L2 replacement produces multiple line writebacks through the shared line engine.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Force ten dirty lines into one L2 set and observe the resulting AXI write transactions.
bins.required_monitor_event: Accepted AW, eight ordered W beats, matching B completion for each victim, and peak outstanding writes of one.
bins.checker: AXI memory agent checks IDs, addresses, beat indices, strobes, completion association, writeback contents, and serialized address order.

bins.feature: Integrated AXI write response error fail-stop
bins.legal_preconditions: A dirty victim write receives an injected non-OKAY BRESP from the backing-memory agent.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Fill one L2 set with eight dirty lines, inject BRESP error on the ninth line's victim writeback.
bins.required_monitor_event: B error handshake for the selected victim followed by system fatal/error status and no successful CPU response.
bins.checker: AXI agent correlates B error to address; APB error CSR and CPU response/fatal state are checked.

bins.feature: Reset cancellation of integrated AXI dirty writeback
bins.legal_preconditions: System reset is asserted after dirty victim AW acceptance and before B completion.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Delay AXI completion, trigger a ninth same-set line, then reset during the accepted write transaction.
bins.required_monitor_event: Reset epoch changes, agent records cancellation of an outstanding write, and no stale CPU response or write completion occurs.
bins.checker: AXI reset-cancellation record, monitor reset epoch, CPU response-valid, completion log, and fatal state.

bins.feature: Concurrent same-address writes from both cores
bins.legal_preconditions: Both CPU lanes offer legal full-word stores to the exact same cacheable address at the same time.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Paired same-address stores with distinct values, then read back the address.
bins.required_monitor_event: Both ownership requests accepted by the Directory and both CPU request lifecycles complete.
bins.checker: Independent reference model applies both stores in observed Directory acceptance order; final CPU read must equal the last accepted writer's value.

bins.feature: Inclusive L2 victim back-invalidates a resident L1 line
bins.legal_preconditions: A clean line remains resident in Core0 L1 while eight other lines are allocated to the same L2 set.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Allocate the target first from Core0, fill seven same-set tags from Core1, then allocate a ninth tag to select the target with the L2 round-robin pointer.
bins.required_monitor_event: Accepted L2 victim snoop for the target/Core0 and accepted L1 metadata commit to I.
bins.checker: Passive victim-snoop/L1-commit monitor checks back-invalidation; a direct Core0 read must issue an AXI refill and return the independently seeded value.

bins.feature: Owner Snoop while an independent cache line refills
bins.legal_preconditions: Core0 owns a dirty line; while Core0 starts a different cold-line read, Core1 requests the dirty line and causes an owner Snoop.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Start a delayed cold refill on Core0 and issue the peer's owner read after the refill AR handshake.
bins.required_monitor_event: AXI AR for the cold line overlaps a Directory context and accepted Snoop/response for the dirty owner line.
bins.checker: CPU data scoreboard checks both values; passive events check AR/Snoop overlap, at least two active Directory contexts, and no protocol error.

bins.feature: Seeded mixed CPU, MMIO, APB and AXI timing traffic
bins.legal_preconditions: One cacheable CPU miss and one mapped MMIO request use separate CPU lanes; APB samples the miss counter during the accepted AXI refill.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Four fixed reproducible seeds vary CPU lane, read/write, byte mask, MMIO operation, CPU response hold, AXI ARREADY stalls and RVALID source gaps.
bins.required_monitor_event: CPU/MMIO handshakes, L1 and Directory commits, MSHR allocation, L2 refill, AXI AR/R and an APB access are observed in the same operation window.
bins.checker: Independent coherence/data model, MMIO byte-array model, APB miss-counter expectation, AXI ID/beat/data agent, and explicit cycle-order assertions all pass before credit.

bins.feature: Same-set Snoop request waits for active refill retirement
bins.legal_preconditions: A remote CPU request to an M-owned line is accepted while a distinct cold-line refill maps to the same L2 set.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Seeded resource-aware sequence creates M ownership, launches the refill and remote GetS concurrently, and selects same-set addresses.
bins.required_monitor_event: CPU request acceptance precedes refill_end; owner-line Directory request and Snoop acceptance occur after refill_end; eight owner-data beats and M-to-S commit are observed.
bins.checker: Independent CPU/reference data checks; owner-data beat index/last/value checks; Directory, Snoop, refill lifecycle ordering and no protocol-error checks. The unqualified internal conflict pulse is not used as evidence.

bins.feature: Distinct-set owner Snoop progresses during an active refill
bins.legal_preconditions: A remote CPU request to an M-owned line is accepted while a distinct cold-line refill maps to another L2 set.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Seeded resource-aware sequence creates M ownership, launches the refill and remote GetS concurrently, and selects distinct-set addresses.
bins.required_monitor_event: Owner-line Directory request, Snoop acceptance/response, owner-data beats and M-to-S commit occur before refill_end.
bins.checker: Independent CPU/reference data checks; owner-data beat index/last/value checks; Directory, Snoop, refill lifecycle ordering and no protocol-error checks.

bins.feature: Paired CPU hit/miss traffic with a dirty inclusive L2 victim
bins.legal_preconditions: Each L1 has four resident lines in one L2 set; one modeled resident is M-owned, and a paired hit plus opposite-core miss causes inclusive eviction.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Fill one L2 set through legal CPU reads, promote the independently predicted next L2 victim to M, then issue a hit/miss pair from both cores.
bins.required_monitor_event: Paired CPU accepts/completions, one matching L2 victim selection, owner snoop/data beats, and AXI writeback.
bins.checker: FullSystemEnv orders model updates by observed CPU/Directory acceptance and compares victim identity, Directory state, L1 invalidation, all owner data beats, AXI address, and backing-memory contents.

bins.feature: Same-set paired cold misses follow observed Directory acceptance order
bins.legal_preconditions: Both cores issue distinct cold lines mapping to one full L2 set; core 0 is intentionally presented one cycle after core 1.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Fill one L2 set, then issue a delayed paired cold-miss request to both cores.
bins.required_monitor_event: Two accepted Directory requests for the requested lines, AXI read bursts, L2 refill writes, grants, and CPU responses.
bins.checker: Paired CPU scoreboard orders state updates by sampled Directory acceptance; MSHRLifecycleChecker correlates slots, AXI IDs, beats, refill writes, grants, and CPU responses.

bins.feature: Repeated paired cold misses cause multiple replacements in one L2 set
bins.legal_preconditions: One L2 set is full and two rounds of paired cold misses target four distinct lines in that set.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Issue two checked paired-miss rounds after legally filling the target set.
bins.required_monitor_event: Four independently predicted and observed L2 victim selections, eight correlated refill bursts, and completed CPU responses.
bins.checker: Independent cache model compares the four victims in order; MSHRLifecycleChecker checks each paired refill lifecycle and returned data.

bins.feature: Every checked integrated refill MSHR allocation retires after its AXI and L2 refill lifecycle
bins.legal_preconditions: One or two distinct cacheable cold misses complete without reset or protocol error.
bins.stimulus_strategy: Pair independent cold misses and allow AXI read responses to complete out of order.
bins.required_monitor_event: MSHR slot allocate/retire, matching AXI AR ID, eight R beats, eight L2 refill writes, Directory grant, and CPU response.
bins.checker: MSHRLifecycleChecker independently correlates every observed slot lifecycle to its AXI ID/address, beat sequence, L2 writes, grant, and CPU response; AXI agent and CPU data checks validate payloads.

crosses.legal_preconditions: Core 0 read request completes with passing data checker.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Directed and random CPU read.
crosses.checker: CPU handshake lifecycle and independent read-data model.

crosses.legal_preconditions: Core 1 read request completes with passing data checker.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Directed and random CPU read.
crosses.checker: CPU handshake lifecycle and independent read-data model.

crosses.legal_preconditions: Core 1 write request completes with a legal byte mask.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Directed and random CPU write.
crosses.checker: CPU lifecycle checker and reference byte-mask state update.

crosses.legal_preconditions: MMIO operation overlaps a distinct peer cacheable miss.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Paired MMIO write and cold cacheable read.
crosses.checker: Independent MMIO and cache scoreboards plus observed AXI/MMIO handshakes.

crosses.legal_preconditions: APB read occurs while a cache AXI refill is outstanding.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: APB CSR read after AR acceptance and before refill completion.
crosses.checker: APB access checker and AXI lifecycle monitor.

crosses.legal_preconditions: A delayed CPU0 MMIO read, CPU1 cacheable miss with outstanding AXI R beats, and APB miss-counter read have overlapping lifecycles.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Four-role directed cross-agent scenario with cycle ordering checked from passive monitor events.
crosses.checker: Independent MMIO/cache data checks, APB counter check, AXI burst/backpressure checks, and explicit request-to-response overlap predicates.

crosses.legal_preconditions: Both CPU lanes issue distinct mapped MMIO writes.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Paired dual-core MMIO write and subsequent readback.
crosses.checker: Per-lane CPU lifecycle plus independent MMIO register model.

crosses.legal_preconditions: AXI or MMIO request is active when reset is asserted.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Delayed AXI and MMIO response reset tests.
crosses.checker: Agent cancellation records and no-stale-response checks.

crosses.legal_preconditions: A cache refill, delayed MMIO transaction, and APB miss-counter read overlap under seeded timing variation.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Six operations under each of four reproducible seeds, with randomized CPU lane assignment, read/write type, byte mask and response hold plus deterministic AXI/MMIO stalls.
crosses.checker: Independent CPU and MMIO models, exact APB miss count, AXI burst checker, and monitor cycle-order checks.

crosses.legal_preconditions: Same-set M-owner Snoop overlaps a different-line refill and follows the same-set serialization contract.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Same-set branch of the seeded resource-aware scenario.
crosses.checker: Checked CPU acceptance, Directory/Snoop/refill ordering and all returned data before credit.

crosses.legal_preconditions: Distinct-set M-owner Snoop overlaps a different-line refill and progresses before refill retirement.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Distinct-set branch of the seeded resource-aware scenario.
crosses.checker: Checked CPU acceptance, Directory/Snoop/refill ordering and all returned data before credit.

crosses.legal_preconditions: Reset asserted while ARVALID is held because ARREADY is low; reset cancels the miss and a post-reset retry returns the initialized data.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Directed system-level scenario with reset asserted only after the specified real handshake stall/gap is passively observed.
crosses.checker: AXI request/response lifecycle monitor, reset-epoch check, no-stale-response check, and post-reset independent data check.

crosses.feature: Reset during an AXI RVALID gap
crosses.legal_preconditions: An AXI read has been accepted and the memory agent inserts an RVALID gap when reset is asserted.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Directed system-level scenario with reset asserted only after the specified real handshake stall/gap is passively observed.
crosses.checker: AXI cancellation record, reset-epoch check, no-stale-response check, and post-reset independent data check.

crosses.legal_preconditions: A dirty L2 victim has reached AWVALID while AWREADY is low; reset cancels it before the address handshake.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Directed system-level scenario with reset asserted only after the specified real handshake stall/gap is passively observed.
crosses.checker: AW handshake observation, reset-epoch check, no write completion after cancellation, and protocol-error check.

crosses.legal_preconditions: A dirty victim write has started and WVALID is held while WREADY is low when reset is asserted.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Directed system-level scenario with reset asserted only after the specified real handshake stall/gap is passively observed.
crosses.checker: AXI write cancellation record, reset-epoch check, no stale completion, and protocol-error check.

crosses.legal_preconditions: A checked CPU response is held while CPU response READY is low, then reset is asserted.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Directed system-level scenario with reset asserted only after the specified real handshake stall/gap is passively observed.
crosses.checker: Reset-epoch check, no stale CPU response, post-reset independent data check, and protocol-error check.

crosses.legal_preconditions: An MMIO request is held while request READY is low when reset is asserted.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Directed system-level scenario with reset asserted only after the specified real handshake stall/gap is passively observed.
crosses.checker: MMIO handshake observation, reset-epoch check, no stale CPU/MMIO response, exactly one post-reset completion, and protocol-error check.

crosses.feature: Paired CPU traffic × same-set dirty L2 victim
crosses.legal_preconditions: Each L1 has four resident lines in one L2 set; one modeled resident is M-owned, and a paired hit plus opposite-core miss causes inclusive eviction.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Fill one L2 set through legal CPU reads, promote the independently predicted next L2 victim to M, then issue a hit/miss pair from both cores.
crosses.checker: FullSystemEnv orders model updates by observed CPU/Directory acceptance and compares victim identity, Directory state, L1 invalidation, all owner data beats, AXI address, and backing-memory contents.

crosses.feature: Paired same-set misses × reverse lane presentation order
crosses.legal_preconditions: Two distinct cold lines map to the same full L2 set and core 0 is delayed by one cycle.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Directed paired miss with delayed core 0 request presentation.
crosses.checker: Directory acceptance order is compared with the driver presentation order and independently predicted replacement sequence.

crosses.feature: Paired miss × repeated full-set L2 replacement
crosses.legal_preconditions: Two rounds of distinct paired cold misses target the same initially full L2 set.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Two consecutive paired-miss rounds against one L2 set.
crosses.checker: Four observed victim addresses must match the independent model in order; all eight refill lifecycles pass MSHR/data checking.

crosses.feature: AXI read ID × internal refill MSHR slot × CPU response
crosses.legal_preconditions: One or two distinct cold misses complete without reset.
crosses.stimulus_strategy: Two concurrent misses with out-of-order AXI R completion and same-set paired-miss replacement rounds.
crosses.checker: Every allocation/retirement is paired with its slot ID, line address, eight AXI beats, eight L2 beats, grant, and CPU response.
